summary: Added a show_speed parameter to TaskProgressColumn in rich/progress.py. When the task has no total and show_speed=True, the column renders speed as iterations per second (e.g. "12.3 it/s") using task.finished_speed or task.speed; otherwise behaviour is unchanged (default False). Added a render_speed helper and a docstring for __init__. Nothing was run or tested, and nothing was committed.
